reply.text:
I appreciate you reaching out, but I need to let you know: coaching someone who is 12 years old is not something I can do. Training at that age needs to be with a parent, a coach in person at a gym or sports club, and ideally under supervision.

If you're 12 and interested in getting stronger, talk to your parents about finding a coach or program nearby who works with young athletes. If you're an adult asking on behalf of a 12-year-old, same thing — they need in-person guidance, not an app.
